# Draft:Zeal (Software Company)

Zeal is an American software company that provides contract lifecycle management software and services. The company is headquartered in New York and was founded in 2019.
| location = New York, United States
| industry = Software as a service, Legal technology, Contract management
| services = Contract lifecycle management software

History
Zeal was founded in 2019 by attorneys and management consultants who previously led sales and legal strategy at Axiom. The company was part of the AngelPad startup accelerator's 2019 cohort.
